title: SeasonDx: a web tool for detecting and characterising seasonality in health time series
description: SeasonDx is an open-source Shiny web application to detect, quantify and characterise seasonality in health time series. Users upload monthly or quarterly series, optionally replace outliers and missing values using STL-based smoothing, and assess seasonality through additive or multiplicative decomposition, seasonal indices, autocorrelation plots and complementary tests: Friedman rank-sum, ARIMA-based Welch and Kruskal-Wallis, an autoregressive R-squared measure of seasonal strength, frequency-domain tests (Bartlett's KS and Fisher's Kappa), and two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Kuiper tests comparing empirical and theoretical seasonal profiles. A live instance is available at https://chrglez.shinyapps.io/SeasonDx/.
